title: Certified-QMC v1.0: Exact Reference Merits for Production Rank-1 Lattice Rules
description: Certified reference-merit tables and replay software for the UNSW fixed 29102 and extensible 39102 rank-1 lattice-rule families. The release supplies exact rational squared shift-averaged worst-case errors in the product-weight Bernoulli-B2 convention, an independently verified 3,740-prime schedule, hash-chained residue chunks, bounded balanced-CRT reconstruction, two universal overflow checks, and one-command selected-entry verification. Upstream generating vectors are keyed by publisher citation and SHA-256 and are not redistributed.
notes: Project-authored tables and documentation are CC-BY-4.0. Source code is Apache-2.0 as stated in the included LICENSE. Third-party generating vectors are not embedded.
